item.title: Captured openbmb/MiniCPM-OCR-1.0-DSpark — 1 GB manifested, license: unclassified

This week aiarchive.info captured 16 open-weight models, including four Sage-S2.1 variants from internlm (base, FP8, Flash, and Flash-FP8) and eight inclusionAI releases spanning ZoomGain 4B and 9B in full and GGUF formats, SingVL_S1_4B (plus GGUF), and Duo 1.0 and 1.2 causal-base and distill builds. MiniMaxAI added two image models, MiniMax-H3-Image and MiniMax-H3-Image-PE. No models were mirrored and no alerts were issued; radar signals flagged new papers referencing DeepSeek and Qwen, including a DeepSeek-V4-Flash KV cache reuse case study.
